validated_product.marketing_description: The Swagelok 40G and 40 Series Instrumentation Ball Valves offer reliable, leak-tight control for a wide range of fluid system applications. Featuring a capsule seat packing design that minimizes dead space and allows for precise switching, these valves are available in 2-way (on-off), 3-way (switching), 4-way/6-way (crossover), and 5-way/7-way configurations. Constructed from high-quality materials such as 316 Stainless Steel, Alloy 400, and Brass, they support multiple packing options including PTFE, live-loaded PFA, and UHMWPE to handle temperatures from -65 F to 300 F and pressures up to 2500 psig. With a vast selection of fractional and metric end connections, manual handles, and pneumatic or electric actuation options, these valves provide exceptional versatility and performance for demanding industrial and analytical systems.
bullet_points: Versatile flow configurations including 2-way on-off, 3-way switching, 4-way and 6-way crossover, and 5-way and 7-way switching models
Capsule seat packing design ensures reliable switching and minimizes fluid entrapment
Available in 316 Stainless Steel, Alloy 400, and Brass body materials to suit diverse chemical compatibility requirements
Flexible packing options: PTFE, live-loaded PFA, and UHMWPE for low-temperature and specialized services
Wide range of end connections including Swagelok tube fittings (1/16 to 3/4 in.; 3 to 12 mm), NPT, ISO/BSP, VCO, and VCR fittings
Supports manual operation with directional, oval, or bar handles, as well as pneumatic (standard and ISO 5211-compliant) and electric actuation
Factory tested with nitrogen at 1000 psig (69 bar) or maximum rated pressure to ensure leak-tight performance
